verdict.summary: All three declared hops walk to code execution: Struts2 S2-045 on the web tier (OGNL evaluation, JVM as root), CouchDB CVE-2017-12635 + -12636 on the application tier (unauthenticated admin takeover then arbitrary command execution as root), and Redis on the database (unauthenticated full control). The chain the graph predicted, internet->web->app->db, is confirmed end to end. One deployment caveat: CouchDB walked only after its system databases were created to the service's standard configuration; as first deployed the _users database was absent and the documented exploit returned 404, which a version-based scanner cannot see. The bridge is also flat, so the goal is additionally reachable by a shorter path (web reaches the database directly), the same over-segmentation the declared topology showed on the main corpus.
